findings.quote: and third, its position in the face of the advent of artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Introduces the UN response to AI as a substantive topic developed later in the speech.

findings.quote: And if for a moment we allow ourselves to believe that the lesson had been learned after so many failures, the arrival of artificial intelligence demonstrates quite something else.
findings.rationale: Introduces criticism of institutional responses to AI, developed in the following passages.

findings.quote: Artificial intelligence, like the division of labor in the case of the pin factory, is an accelerator of productivity growth.
findings.rationale: Argues that AI raises productivity and disputes catastrophic economic predictions.

findings.quote: That is why I tell you that when it comes to artificial intelligence, Argentina will stand at the forefront of freedom. We have the critical minerals, the energy, the talent and the capacity to compete at every link in that value chain.
findings.rationale: Opposes state control of AI and promotes national participation in the AI value chain.

findings.quote: a commitment not to regulate preemptively, limited liability for companies operating with AI agents and tax incentives.
findings.rationale: Proposes regulatory and tax measures to attract AI development.
